fnol_text: My name is Elena Pereira and I live at 737 Thornbury Avenue, Madison, WI 53751. You can reach me on (555) 752-1132 or elena.pereira@example.com. On 25 July 2024 the Calder River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2024-00077. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Pereira on (555) 752-1132 to acknowledge the claim. Elena confirmed the loss date as 25 July 2024.
Site visit to 737 Thornbury Avenue. Neighbour Yusuf Thorne was present and confirmed the timeline.
Elena sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
